cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This site uses cookies to remember your language and to measure how the site is used.

home.metaDescription: Six international scientific conferences in Samarkand, Uzbekistan. Registration, deadlines, participation fees and venue information.
home.heroAlt: Geometric banner in the site colours
home.heroSubtitle: Present your work, publish it in open access, and meet researchers from more than forty countries.
home.conferencesIntro: Six international conferences take place in Samarkand in August 2026. Each has its own programme, topics and organising committee.
home.partnersIntro: Universities and research institutes taking part in the organisation of the conferences.

newsletter.heading: Subscribe to our newsletter
newsletter.body: Receive calls for papers, deadline reminders and programme updates. One or two messages per month.
newsletter.success: Thank you. Your address has been added to the list.
newsletter.errorGeneric: The subscription could not be saved. Please try again later.

conference.topicsIntro: Submissions are accepted in the following areas.
conference.registerBody: Registration includes your presentation, publication of the paper, a certificate and access to all sessions of the conference.
conference.venueBody: Sessions, poster displays and coffee breaks all take place at the same address. Accommodation options and travel notes are listed on the venue page.
conference.committeeIntro: The committee reviews submissions and sets the scientific programme.

register.metaDescription: Register for an international scientific conference in Samarkand. Personal details, presentation type and article abstract.
register.heading: Registration form
register.intro: Fields marked with an asterisk are required. You will receive a confirmation email with your registration number after the form is submitted.
register.secondEmailHint: Used only if the first address bounces.
register.participatedLastYearLabel: I took part in last year's edition
register.phdUnder30Label: I am a PhD student under 30
register.secondArticleToggle: I want to present a second article

register.errorHeading: The form could not be sent
register.errorBody: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.

validation.country: Choose a country from the list.
validation.conference: Choose a conference from the list.
validation.consent: You must accept the Terms of Use to register.

upload.metaDescription: Submit your manuscript, abstract, presentation or poster for an international scientific conference.
upload.heading: Send manuscript or presentation
upload.intro: Register first: the confirmation email contains the registration number required by this form.
upload.notice1: Submitting a manuscript is optional. A presentation or poster is enough to take part.
upload.notice2: Work already published elsewhere cannot be accepted.
upload.notice3: Manuscripts and abstracts must be sent as .DOC or .DOCX, never as PDF. Presentations and posters may be .PPT, .PPTX or .PDF.
upload.interimHeading: File upload is not available yet
upload.interimBody: Send the file as an email attachment to {email}. Put your registration number and the conference name in the subject line.

payment.metaDescription: Participation fees, what the fee includes, accepted payment methods and bank details.
payment.heading: Participation fee and payment
payment.intro: The fee is the same for all six conferences. Amounts are in euro and cover one participant.
payment.included1: Presentation of one paper as a talk or a poster
payment.included2: Publication of the paper in the conference proceedings
payment.included4: Access to all sessions of the conference
payment.included5: Printed programme and the abstract book as a PDF
payment.methodsBody: Payment is accepted by bank transfer and by card (VISA, MasterCard). All bank charges are paid by the sender.
payment.invoiceBody: An invoice for an organisation is issued when the invoice section of the registration form is completed. Invoices for individuals are issued on request after payment.

deadlines.metaDescription: Registration, payment and submission deadlines for each of the six international scientific conferences.
deadlines.heading: Important dates and deadlines
deadlines.intro: Deadlines apply to each conference separately. Late registration is possible while places remain, at the late fee.

venue.metaDescription: Conference venue in Samarkand, accommodation options, travel and visa notes.
venue.heading: Venue and accommodation
venue.cityBody: Samarkand is one of the oldest cities in Central Asia and a UNESCO World Heritage site. It lies about 280 km south-west of Tashkent and is reached by high-speed train in roughly two hours, or by direct flight.
venue.venueBody: All sessions, poster displays and coffee breaks take place at the same address. Rooms are equipped with a projector, screen and microphone. Poster boards are provided in A0 portrait format.
venue.mapAlt: Schematic map showing the conference venue
venue.mapNote: Map placeholder. TODO: replace with an embedded map before launch.
venue.accommodationBody: Participants book their own accommodation. The properties below are within walking distance of the venue. Prices and availability are the responsibility of each property.
venue.fraudBody: The organisers do not arrange accommodation, do not take room payments and never contact participants to request card details. Treat any such message as fraudulent.
venue.travelBody: Citizens of many countries may enter Uzbekistan without a visa or with an electronic visa. Check the current requirements for your citizenship well before travelling. An invitation letter can be issued after the participation fee is received.

photos.heading: Photo gallery
photos.intro: Images from previous conferences. TODO: replace the placeholders with real photographs.

about.metaDescription: About the organiser of the international scientific conferences held in Samarkand.
about.heading: About us
about.lead: We organise six international scientific conferences each year and publish the papers presented at them in open access.
about.body1: The conferences bring together researchers from universities, research institutes and industry. Each event has its own organising committee, which reviews the submitted abstracts and builds the scientific programme.
about.body2: Papers accepted for presentation are published in the conference proceedings and remain freely available. Authors keep the copyright in their work.
about.legalBody: TODO: replace with the registered company name, tax number and registered address of the organiser.

contacts.metaDescription: Contact details and enquiry form for the international scientific conferences.
contacts.heading: Contacts
contacts.intro: For questions about registration, payment or the programme, use the form below or write to us directly.
contacts.submissionNote: Do not send manuscripts, abstracts, presentations or posters to these addresses. Use the submission page instead.
contacts.successBody: Thank you. We reply to most enquiries within two working days.
contacts.errorGeneric: The message could not be sent. Please try again later or write to us by email.
contacts.errorUnavailable: The contact form is temporarily unavailable. Please write to us by email.

terms.metaDescription: Terms of use for the conference website and conditions of participation.
terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.updated: Placeholder text. TODO: replace with the reviewed terms before launch.
terms.s1Body: These terms cover the use of this website and participation in the conferences announced on it. Submitting the registration form means accepting them.
terms.s2Body: A registration becomes valid once the participation fee has been received. Fees paid are not refundable, but a registration may be transferred to another person from the same organisation.
terms.s3Body: Authors confirm that the submitted work is their own and has not been published elsewhere. Authors keep the copyright and grant the organisers the right to publish the paper in the conference proceedings.
terms.s4Body: The organisers may change the programme, the session order or the venue if circumstances require it. Participants are informed by email.
terms.s5Body: The organisers are not responsible for travel or accommodation arrangements made by participants, nor for personal belongings during the event.

privacy.metaDescription: How personal data submitted through this website is collected, used and stored.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.updated: Placeholder text. TODO: replace with the reviewed policy before launch.
privacy.s1Body: Through the registration, newsletter and contact forms we collect the details you enter: name, organisation, country, address, phone, email, and the title and abstract of your article.
privacy.s2Body: The data is used to organise the conference, issue invoices and certificates, publish the proceedings, and send programme information. The newsletter address is used only to send announcements.
privacy.s3Body: Form submissions are stored in a spreadsheet held in the organisers' account with a cloud provider, accessible only to the organising team.
privacy.s4Body: Registration data is kept for as long as the proceedings remain published. Newsletter addresses are kept until you unsubscribe.
privacy.s5Body: You may ask for a copy of your data, ask for it to be corrected, or ask for it to be deleted. Write to the email address on the contacts page.
privacy.s6Body: The site stores your language choice and your cookie decision in the browser. No advertising cookies are used.
